blocks.title: Network Architecture, Isolation, and SDN comparison
Network Architecture, Isolation, and SDN exam shortcuts
items: Example: A sensitive system has no normal LAN connection.
VLAN or firewall zone → LOGICAL SEGMENTATION
Example: Finance and engineering use different VLANs.
Example: A control network uses dedicated switches.
Central controller programs the network → SDN
Example: An SDN controller pushes segmentation rules.
blocks.example: Choose the architecture based on the security tradeoff emphasized in the scenario.

questions.q: A sensitive environment uses completely separate switches and cabling from the corporate LAN. Which concept best fits?
questions.explanation: Physical isolation relies on distinct physical infrastructure.

questions.q: A classified system has no direct network connection to any less trusted network. Which design is this?
questions.explanation: An air-gapped system has no direct network connection.

questions.q: Finance and engineering share switches but use different VLANs with firewall rules between them. Which concept is this?
questions.explanation: Logical segmentation creates separation through configuration.

questions.q: A central controller programs routing and segmentation policies across many network devices. Which model is this?
questions.explanation: SDN uses centralized programmable network control.
